use_when: Use type dropzone where people add files: attachments in messages and support requests, room photos and verification documents in the back office.
Use type item for each file once it is added, in a list under the drop zone, with its name, type and size.
Show state uploading with the progress while a file is sending, and state error with the reason when a file is refused.
Put the accepted types and the size limit in the Hint, such as "PDF, JPG or PNG · 10 MB each".
Say what went wrong and how to fix it in the error, such as "Too large: the limit is 10 MB".
Keep the whole drop zone clickable, so "browse" works without dragging, on touch screens too.

dont_use_when.when: To show a document people download but never upload, such as a receipt or invoice: use a Link or a table row.
For a profile photo: use Avatar with its own upload action.
Do not hide the limits: never leave the Hint empty.

variant_intent.dropzone: where people add files: attachments in messages and support requests, room photos and verification documents in the back office.
variant_intent.item: for each file once it is added, in a list under the drop zone, with its name, type and size.

a11y.fact: The dropzone is a <label> wrapping a native <input type="file"> (visually the whole zone), so clicking anywhere on it, or Tab then Enter/Space, opens the browser's file picker and works on touch without dragging.
The file input is described by the hint text (aria-describedby), so accepted types and size limit are announced with it.
The input is natively disabled when disabled is set, and the dropzone shows a focus outline on keyboard focus.
The item's meta line has role="alert" in state error, so the reason is announced.
The item's type badge is aria-hidden, and its Remove/Cancel action is a native <button type="button">.
